notes:
WI-08 (UC-009) — GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers + GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers/{id:guid} (FleetAdmin).

== WHAT WAS DELIVERED ==

1. ENDPOINT: GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers (FleetAdminOnly, DontCatchExceptions).
   Response sections:
   - Drivers: List<DriverLeagueRowDto> — all active fleet drivers, sorted by RidesCompleted DESC.
     Per driver: RidesCompleted, RevenueCzk, OnlineHours (from driver_shifts clamped to window),
     UtilizationPct (busy_seconds/online_seconds×100 where busy=accepted_at→completed_at sum),
     RevenuePerOnlineHour, AcceptanceRate (completed/(completed+declined)×100),
     AvgTimeToAcceptSeconds (AVG assigned_at→accepted_at for completed rides),
     DeclinesAndTimeouts (Cancelled + assigned_at IS NOT NULL + accepted_at IS NULL),
     Cancellations (Cancelled + accepted_at IS NOT NULL, post-acceptance),
     NoShows (Cancelled + accepted_at IS NOT NULL + arrived_at IS NOT NULL),
     AvgRating (nullable — null when no rated rides).
   - Retention: List<RetentionBucketDto> per ISO week in window.
     Active = ≥1 completed ride in week.
     NewlyActivated = first-ever all-time completed ride is in this week.
     Churned = had ≥1 completed ride ever before weekEnd, but last ride < (weekEnd - 14 days).
   - Prior: GetDriversPriorDto? — both Drivers and Retention recomputed for prior equal-length
     window when compare=true; null otherwise.

2. ENDPOINT: GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers/{id:guid} (FleetAdminOnly, DontCatchExceptions).
   Request: GetDriverDrilldownRequest (extends AnalyticsRangeRequest, adds Guid Id from route).
   Response: GetDriverDrilldownResponse with DriverId, Name, WeeklyTrend, LowRatedOrders.
   - WeeklyTrend: ISO week buckets with RidesCompleted, RevenueCzk, AvgRating (nullable).
   - LowRatedOrders: Top 20 completed orders with rating_stars ≤ 3, ordered CompletedAt DESC.
     Loaded via LINQ (in-memory mapping) to avoid JsonDocument projection issue (CLAUDE.md trap).
   - Tenant isolation: dbContext.Drivers with EF global query filter → 404 for cross-fleet driver.
     Checked before aggregation, not via SQL fleet_id guard on aggregates.

3. SQL PATTERNS:
   - League table: 4 separate GROUP BY queries (rides, declines, cancellations, shifts) merged in memory.
     All fleet drivers loaded in one batch join (Drivers JOIN Users) — no N+1, includes zero-activity drivers.
   - Raw SQL uses explicit casts: COUNT(*)::int, SUM(...)::int, EXTRACT(...)::float8.
   - Retention: 3 SqlQuery<CountRow> calls per ISO week (Active, NewlyActivated, Churned).
     NewlyActivated uses subquery over all-time orders (not limited to window).
     Churned uses MAX(completed_at) < (weekEnd - 14 days) subquery over all-time orders before weekEnd.
   - Drilldown weekly trend: date_trunc('week', ...) GROUP BY, snake_case alias 'weekstart'.
   - IMPORTANT: EF global query filters apply to LINQ (Drivers, Users) but NOT to SqlQuery.
     SqlQuery calls carry explicit WHERE fleet_id = {fleetId}.

4. OPENAPI ALLOWLIST: Added both 'GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers' and 'GET /api/v1/analytics/drivers/{id}'
   to SeedAndEndToEndTests expected HashSet. docs/api.md regenerated by the test.

5. TESTS (7 total: 6 functional + 1 perf opt-in):
   - HandleAsync_HandComputedFixture_RanksTwoDrivers: 2 drivers with known rides/shifts/declines.
     Driver A: 2 completed rides 150+150=300 CZK, 1h shift, 0 declines → 100% acceptance, 300s avg.
     Driver B: 1 completed ride 200 CZK, 2h shift, 1 decline → 50% acceptance, 600s avg.
     Asserts all league metrics including AvgRating (4.5 and 3.0).
   - HandleAsync_DrillDown_ReturnsWeeklyTrendAndLowRated: 3 rides in 2 weeks + 1 low-rated (2-star).
     Asserts WeeklyTrend has 2 entries; LowRatedOrders has 1 entry with comment.
   - HandleAsync_LeagueTable_TenantsIsolated: Fleet A 2 drivers, Fleet B 3 drivers.
     Fleet A admin sees exactly 2 drivers (zero-activity drivers included via all-drivers query).
   - HandleAsync_DrillDown_CrossFleetDriver_Returns404: Driver from Fleet B → 404 for Fleet A admin.
   - HandleAsync_Retention_ClassifiesActivatedAndChurned: 3 drivers across 2 ISO weeks.
     Verifies week1: Active=2, NewlyActivated=1, Churned=0.
     Verifies week2: Active=0, NewlyActivated=0, Churned=1 (Z: last ride Sep3 < Sep7=churnCutoff).
   - HandleAsync_CompareTrueWithPriorRides_ReturnsPriorBlock: compare=true populates Prior block.
     Driver A: 1 ride in prior window (Sep 2), 2 rides in current (Sep 9-10).
     Driver B: current-only (1 ride Sep 10). Prior.Drivers: A has 1 ride, B has 0 rides.
     Prior.Retention: ISO week Aug 31 (Mon before Sep 1 Tue) has Active=1 (Driver A rode Sep 2).
     NOTE: retention week label is Aug 31 not Sep 1 because Sep 1 2026 is a Tuesday.
   - HandleAsync_50kSeed_RespondsUnder500ms: [Trait('Category','Perf')] opt-in via RUN_PERF_TESTS=1.
     50k orders across 20 drivers. compare=true exercises doubled compute path. NOT measured (skipped).

== DESIGN DECISIONS ==

- Zero-activity drivers: ALL active fleet drivers appear in the league table (zero rides, zero revenue, etc.).
  This matches the 'all drivers visible' intention — a driver with no rides in the window is still listed.
  Loaded via one LINQ batch join (Drivers WHERE fleetId AND isActive JOIN Users).

- Declined+timeout definition: Orders where driver was assigned (assigned_at IS NOT NULL) then cancelled
  before accepting (accepted_at IS NULL). This captures both driver-explicit declines and system timeouts.
  The CancelledByRole column is not used for this metric (timeout has no actor).

- Cancellations vs No-Shows: NoShows is a subset of Cancellations (arrived_at IS NOT NULL).
  Both are counted from post-acceptance cancellations. Cancellations count includes no-shows.

- Drill-down request: A small GetDriverDrilldownRequest extends AnalyticsRangeRequest with the Guid Id
  route parameter. Deviation from designer's files_touched (no request file listed) justified because
  adding Id to the shared AnalyticsRangeRequest would affect 6 other endpoints.

- Drill-down compare: Not implemented (WI spec says no compare on drill-down). The endpoint always
  resolves compare=false even if compare=true is passed in the URL.

- Retention churn formula: A driver is churned in week W if their last-ever completed ride before W.End
  is more than 14 days before W.End (i.e., last_ride < W.End - 14 days). This matches the spec:
  'previously active with no completed ride in trailing 14 days ending at week_end'.

- ISO week generation: Computed by aligning winStart to the preceding Monday using
  ((dayOfWeek + 6) % 7) offset pattern (0=Mon in ISO). Weeks iterate forward until winEnd.
  TRAP: Sep 1 2026 is a Tuesday, so retention for a Sep 1-7 prior window generates a week
  starting Aug 31 (the preceding Monday), labeled '2026-08-31' not '2026-09-01'.

== TRAPS CARRIED FORWARD ==

- LINQ join with EF global filters is the isolation mechanism for the drivers list (not SQL WHERE fleet_id).
  The SqlQuery calls for ride/shift aggregates carry explicit WHERE fleet_id = {fleetId} to compensate
  because SqlQuery bypasses EF global filters.

- Retention subqueries look at ALL-TIME orders (not window-limited) for newly-activated and churned
  classification. Window-limiting these queries would incorrectly classify historical drivers.

- No N+1: The 'all fleet drivers' join loads names in one batch. The 4 aggregate SQL queries each
  hit the DB once (not per driver). Retention hits DB 3× per ISO week — acceptable for typical
  window sizes (1–12 weeks). A future optimization could combine into a single CTE.

- Perf test is self-skipping (RUN_PERF_TESTS != '1'). The handoff reports 'not measured' for the
  actual perf number. The test infrastructure is ready for CI opt-in.
